name: WorldSimProbe: Diagnosing Simulator Faithfulness in Action-Conditioned World Models for Embodied Manipulation

hidden_official_scoring_references.policy: Do not access, mirror or infer hidden reference labels. Public local validation examples are distinct from official hidden scoring references.

task_semantics.task_1: Small/large action perturbation response ratio compared with hidden simulator response ratio.
task_semantics.task_2: Donor action stream in receiver scene, robot-masked optical-flow similarity against simulator reference.
task_semantics.task_3: Action-source preservation across policy/expert/human traces; synthetic human-like profiles are not accepted as real teleoperation.
task_semantics.task_4: Distractor/fake-contact/proximity hallucination checks with object displacement and robot-arm motion gates.
task_semantics.task_5: Eight-way interaction primitive classification with agent-motion/object-motion agreement checks and shared physical-time sampling.

evaluator_dependencies.cuda_worker: Tasks 2-4 require NVIDIA CUDA for RobotSeg/DPFlow/TAPNext++ stack.
evaluator_dependencies.versioning_policy: Pin exact model/checkpoint revisions, Python lock, simulator assets and CUDA runtime before reproduction. The README's minimum package requirements are not a fully resolved runtime lock.

reproduction_policy.no_vendoring: Keep WorldSimProbe as an isolated external evaluator; consume validated reports and digests from the pinned run.
reproduction_policy.public_validation: Use only the explicitly released local validation split for evaluator smoke; do not substitute it for hidden official qualification.
reproduction_policy.wrapper_normalization: Keep native video sampling/action-source/metric protocol as a paper-native track. CMAQ-normalized intervention runs must be labelled adapted and must not overwrite native scores.

claim_ceiling: Source and task contract pinned for adapter planning. No reproduction, matched comparison, model result or SOTA claim.
